codeReview.summary: Two targeted fixes correctly implemented: (1) pump_configs[5] bit decode bug fixed from bits 6-7 to bits 2-3 of payload[6], matching the sequential 2-bit packing pattern used by pumps 0-4. New test covers all three PumpConfig variants (None, SingleSpeed, TwoSpeed) and verifies pump4 (bits 0-1) is unaffected. (2) Dead code line `payload[11] = 0x09` removed from test_parse_status_pumps_and_circ_blower — it was immediately overwritten by the next line. Both fixes are minimal, correct, and well-tested.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Protocol documentation (docs/protocol.md lines 108-109) only documents Pump 5 at bits 0-1 and Pump 6 at bits 6-7 of payload byte 6, but does NOT document bits 2-5 of that byte. The sequential 2-bit packing pattern (pump0=bits 0-1 through pump3=bits 6-7 of payload[5], pump4=bits 0-1, pump5=bits 2-3 of payload[6]) is a reasonable inference but the protocol doc has a gap — bits 2-5 of byte 6 are undocumented. This should be noted in .factory/library/ or docs/protocol.md to prevent future confusion.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: docs/protocol.md:108-109 shows '6 | 0-1 | Pump 5' and '6 | 6-7 | Pump 6' with bits 2-5 of byte 6 completely undocumented. The fix uses bits 2-3 for pump5 (previously used bits 6-7 which conflict with documented Pump 6).
